up: List all approved drugs (molecules with max_phase = 4 in molecule_dictionary) that have a COVID-19 indication, meaning a record in drug_indication where mesh_heading contains 'COVID-19' or efo_term contains 'COVID-19'. Return the drug name (pref_name) and ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), with duplicate rows removed.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (di.mesh_heading LIKE '%COVID-19%' OR di.efo_term LIKE '%COVID-19%');
